step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled LC oscillator with a tail current source and an NMOS switch connected directly across the differential tank nodes. The switch acts as a direct injection-locking element when driven by a high-frequency input, allowing the circuit to function as a wide-locking-range frequency divider.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the oscillator core from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VBIAS=0.7V, Vth=0.42V, Vov=0.28V. Tail current Id = 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * (40/0.15) * (0.28)^2 ≈ 2.8 mA. Power = 2.8 mA * 1.8 V = 5.04 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and typical RF bias currents to ensure reliable oscillation startup.

oscillation_frequency.description: The free-running frequency of the oscillator when no injection signal is applied.

sky130_expected.calculation: Using a testbench LC tank with L=2nH and C=1pF. f = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)) = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(2e-9 * 1e-12)) ≈ 3.56 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down to ~3.5 GHz for robust testbench demonstration using standard lumped L and C values.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the single-ended output node (Q or QX).

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing is limited by voltage headroom. V_TAIL ≈ 1.1V, leaving 0.7V peak amplitude. Peak-to-peak single-ended swing ≈ 1.4V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on current-limited vs voltage-limited regimes in a cross-coupled LC oscillator operating at 1.8V.

locking_range.description: The range of input frequencies over which the oscillator successfully locks to the injected signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends heavily on injection signal amplitude and tank Q. Typically 5-10% of the free-running frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires a frequency sweep to measure accurately; estimated based on typical DILO performance.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the free-running oscillation frequency, power consumption, and voltage swing of the DILO circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Override default parameters for RF operation
.param W_xm1=20u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=40u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=10u L_xm4=0.15u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.7
VIN IN 0 DC 0

* LC Tank
L1 VDD Q 2n
L2 VDD QX 2n
C1 Q 0 1p
C2 QX 0 1p
R1 Q VDD 300
R2 QX VDD 300

* DUT
XM1 Q QX TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 QX Q TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 TAIL BIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 Q IN QX VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Initial condition to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(Q)=1.8 v(QX)=0

.control
tran 10p 20n

* 1. Power consumption
meas tran avg_I avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
let power = -avg_I * 1.8
print power

* 2. Oscillation frequency
meas tran t1 trig v(Q) val=1.8 rise=20
meas tran t2 trig v(Q) val=1.8 rise=30
let osc_freq = 10 / (t2 - t1)
print osc_freq

* 3. Voltage swing
meas tran vmax max v(Q) from=10n to=20n
meas tran vmin min v(Q) from=10n to=20n
let v_swing = vmax - vmin
print v_swing

quit
.endc
